exposure: Surgical repair of diastasis recti abdominis (DRA) with suture plication of the linea alba
cohort: Sixty post-partum women with diastasis recti abdominis (DRA) and training-resistant core dysfunctions were included in the study.
finding: Surgical reconstruction of diastasis recti abdominis (DRA) led to functional improvements in abdominal core function, urinary incontinence, and quality of life that persisted for 3 years post-surgery.
